title: Which variable can fail soonest?
hook: The next variable should be chosen from the choices that still survive.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Choose the smallest remaining legal domain after propagation rather than a fixed variable order.

misconception: Starting with the variable having the most options avoids backtracking.
objective: Choose the smallest remaining legal domain after propagation rather than a fixed variable order.

claims.text: Propagation first removes Y’s unsupported value and then removes X’s conflict with Y’s singleton. Among the remaining unassigned variables, MRV chooses the smaller legal domain. The comparison skips propagation, exposing the stale domain sizes even when the selected variable agrees.
